title: The Housemaid's Secret
author: Freida McFadden
summary: A second book about Millie, who is trying to hold her life together and takes a new job in a wealthy household. Things there soon start to feel wrong in ways she knows how to spot.
readIf: you like quick, twisty domestic thrillers with unreliable surfaces and cliffhanger chapters.
skipIf: you want realistic, slow-building suspense or prefer to avoid violence in thrillers.

pairings.reason: The first book in the series, which sets up Millie and her history.
Another thriller with a cast of secretive people in a closed setting and a payoff that reframes the story.
A more claustrophobic psychological thriller about a household that hides something terrible.
